description.zh:
是否强制删除应用。取值范围：

- true
- false
description.en:
Specifies whether to forcibly delete the application. Valid values:

*   true
*   false
The region ID. Set the value to cn-hangzhou.

description.zh:
是否保留应用管理创建的资源
- true
- false
description.en:
Specifies whether to retain resources created by application manager when deleting the application. Valid values:
- true
- false

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oos delete-application --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name MyApplication --biz-force false --retain-resource false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oos DeleteApplication --region cn-hangzhou --RetainResource false --Force false --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Name MyApplication
